welcome_message: Hello! 👋 Welcome to Dude AI Security Assistant. What would you like to check today?
user_instructions: Review the detected security findings below. You can select an individual vulnerability category or import all sample security issues into your connected Jira project.
selection_prompt: Select a vulnerability category to preview and import, or choose 'All Categories' to import the full security test suite.
description: Combined master security vulnerability template catalog and interactive security assistant prompt for Dude AI.

fields.description: Sample security finding: passwords may be exposed through API responses, application logs, or error messages. Verify in an authorized test environment.
fields.risk: High risk of credential exposure, unauthorized account access, and lateral system compromise.
fields.recommendation: Never log or transmit plaintext credentials; enforce strong hashing (Argon2id/bcrypt), HTTPS, and sanitize sensitive values from all API responses and logs.

fields.description: Sample security finding: internal user identifiers may be exposed or user records may be accessible without proper authorization.
fields.risk: Internal account enumeration, identity harvesting, and targeted credential stuffing attacks.
fields.recommendation: Mask internal IDs, enforce robust authorization checks on user resource endpoints, and use opaque UUIDs instead of sequential IDs.

fields.description: Sample security finding: confidential revenue figures or financial reports may be accessible without appropriate permissions.
fields.risk: Leakage of sensitive financial records leading to business intelligence compromise and regulatory compliance violations.
fields.recommendation: Enforce role-based access control (RBAC), tenant isolation, and strict server-side authorization on all financial and reporting endpoints.

fields.description: Sample security finding: a file upload may contain suspicious content that requires investigation using approved security tools in an isolated environment.
fields.risk: Remote code execution, host system compromise, ransomware deployment, and lateral network infection.
fields.recommendation: Implement automated antivirus/antimalware scanning, validate file types using magic bytes, restrict file extensions, and store uploads in isolated, non-executable storage buckets.

fields.description: Sample security finding: a protected API endpoint may fail to verify whether a user is authorized to access a requested resource.
fields.risk: Broken object level authorization (BOLA/IDOR), allowing unprivileged users to read, modify, or delete arbitrary user data.
fields.recommendation: Validate user identity and permissions server-side on every API request; verify resource ownership before granting access.

fields.summary: Sensitive Data Leakage in API Response
fields.description: Sample security finding: an API response may expose confidential personal or business information that is not required by the client.
fields.risk: Privacy violations under GDPR/CCPA, sensitive metadata harvesting, and downstream exploitation.
fields.recommendation: Use explicit API data transfer objects (DTOs) / Pydantic schemas to filter out sensitive internal fields before serializing responses.
